messages:
hana: Flagging a leak: a contractor uploaded a vendor tarball to our intake bucket that contains a plaintext SA JSON for svc-supply@redwood-prod. found during routine artifact review. treat as compromise.
liam: ack. any evidence of use? where did the bundle go?
hana: bundle was mirrored to eu-backups and a few CI runs referenced it. audit shows a few token exchanges yesterday. we need a controlled rotation and cross-region audit capture.
gabe: propose sequence: 1) generate replacement key, 2) encrypt/wrap with Vault transit and put under a versioned KV path, 3) switch consumers via a canary flag, 4) after verification revoke old key, 5) run repository + artifact scans. include replication check because Vault async replication to EU can lag.
registry-bot: I pushed a draft TF PR at https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/1602 updating iam bindings and creating vault path secret/supply/svc-supply/v2.
liam: RBAC change: remove legacy project-level roles (editor/owner) from the service account and grant only `roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` to the runtime agents and `roles/storage.objectViewer` scoped to the vendor bucket.
audit-bot: will export all related Create/DeleteServiceAccountKey and KMS rewrap events for the last 120 days to longterm table `sec_mgr.rotation_logs_4923456789`. filter used: `protoPayload.methodName:("CreateServiceAccountKey" OR "DeleteServiceAccountKey") AND resource.labels.service_account_id:svc-supply`
sre-oncall: replication note: wait for Vault replication index parity before deleting old key. use `vault read sys/replication/status` and verify applied_index >= last_write_index on eu cluster. allow 3m buffer.
hana: minimal runbook for staging: ```
# 1 create key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create new-key.json --iam-account=svc-supply@redwood-prod
# 2 wrap + store in vault
vault write transit/rotor plaintext=@new-key.json
vault kv put secret/supply/svc-supply/v2 key_cipher=@ciphertext
# 3 enable canary 5%
kubectl set env deploy/supply-agent SUPPLY_KEY_PATH=secret/supply/svc-supply/v2 SUPPLY_CANARY=5 -n prod
# 4 smoke test and monitor logs
# 5 promote then revoke old key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete OLD_KEY_ID --iam-account=svc-supply@redwood-prod
```
gabe: post-revoke scans: run trufflehog on mirrors, container image layer scans, and a grep for JSON key signatures across mono-repo. sample grep: `rg \"private_key\"\s*:\s*\"-----BEGIN\" --hidden`
liam: also notify vendor to confirm they removed copies and request their retention purge certificate. compliance-bot: note: open a compliance ticket because backup replication crossed regions and audit exports are being created. attach vendor confirmation and the BQ export.
hana: owners: hana=incident lead, gabe=runbook+scans, liam=rbac+tf, audit-bot=log export, sre-oncall=replication check+smoke tests. scheduling: staging smoke Fri 09:00 PT, prod canary Mon 06:00 PT, promote Mon 07:00 PT if green. I'll post final runbook and calendar invite. :white_check_mark:
